name: svg-mask-effect

frames.best_why: Frame 2 puts the black spotlight dot right on the sentence, the clearest view of it tracking the pointer.

tagline: A black torch follows the mouse, uncovering a second message in the text.
summary: A white panel of bold statement text with a small black spotlight that tracks the pointer. Hovering opens the spotlight wide and darkens the panel to show a different sentence underneath.
appearance: A wide white panel holding one block of large bold near-black text, a two-sentence rule with DO NOT in capitals, centred in the space. A tiny solid black dot, the spotlight mask, sits somewhere on the text, and in one frame the whole panel has shifted to pale grey.
behaviour: A black circular mask follows the pointer across the copy, a small dot by default that only hints at a white-on-black layer beneath. Moving the pointer onto the text grows the circle very wide as the panel darkens to navy, uncovering that second sentence, and leaving shrinks it again.
demo_content: A two-sentence joke about the first and second rules of MRR Club, ending DO NOT talk about MRR Club.
search_phrases: black circle following the mouse over text
flashlight over a sentence to uncover words
reveal a secret line with a torch
use_when: A short statement should hide a second message that only appears under the cursor.
avoid_when: The hidden message must be readable on touch or keyboard, or the copy has to be discoverable.
customise: children is the hidden layer inside the mask and revealText is what shows at rest; size and revealSize set the dot and expanded diameter. The white, navy and black colours are hardcoded.
weight_why: Two text layers and one masked div whose position and size motion updates.

a11y.note: The reveal is pointer-only with no keyboard or focus route, and the mask ignores reduced-motion.

issues: The recording never shows the payoff: the wide spotlight and the second message stay hidden.
At rest the only cue is a ten-pixel black dot, so the hidden layer is easy to miss entirely.
polish_why: Clean, confident type on white, but it shows only a tiny dot, not the reveal it exists for.
